commands.name: generate

options.name: --assemblies
options.description: Comma-separated list of assembly paths to analyze

options.name: --emit-public-visibility
options.description: Render an explicit "public" visibility  segment for public events (e.g. public.domain.subdomain.topic.v1). Default:  false (public events omit the segment, e.g. domain.subdomain.topic.v1). Internal events always render "internal" regardless of this flag.

options.name: --event-attribute
options.description: Name (or name prefix) of the attribute used to  discover events. Default: EventTopicAttribute

options.name: --format
options.description: Serialization format for payload size calculation  (json, binary)

options.name: --github-url
options.description: Base GitHub URL for source code links (e.g.,  https://github.com/org/repo/blob/main/src)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for generated markdown files

options.name: --partition-key-attribute
options.description: Name (or name prefix) of the attribute used to  discover partition keys. Default: PartitionKeyAttribute

options.name: --sidebar-file
options.description: Name of the JSON sidebar file

options.name: --source-root
options.description: Path to the source checkout root (the parent of each  project's folder, e.g. the parent of src/AppDomain/). When set, a GitHub  source link is only emitted if the guessed file actually exists under this root; otherwise it falls back to "#" instead of a possibly wrong link.  Optional; has no effect without --github-url.

options.name: --templates
options.description: Custom templates directory to override default  templates

options.name: --xml-docs
options.description: Comma-separated list of XML documentation file paths  (auto-discovered if not provided)

commands.description: Generate markdown documentation from event assemblies

commands.name: templates

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing template files if they exist

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for template files (defaults to  ./templates)

commands.description: Copy default templates to a local directory for  customization
